skill.name: theme-factory
skill.description: Apply one of ten curated color and typography themes to presentations and other artifacts, or create a custom theme from user requirements.
skill.summary: Apply consistent color palettes and font pairings to presentations, documents, reports, and web artifacts.
skill.author: davila7

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks format the local filename theme-showcase.pdf as inline Markdown. The instruction only asks the agent to display the PDF and explicitly forbids modifying it.
The backticks format a reference to the local theme-showcase.pdf file. No shell syntax, executable command, or dynamic input is present.
The backticks identify the local themes directory in prose. This is a Markdown path reference, not Ruby or shell execution.
The backticks identify the local themes directory that contains theme specifications. Reading a bundled theme file does not invoke an external command.

content.value_statement: Inconsistent colors and typography weaken visual artifacts. Theme Factory applies curated or custom palettes and font pairings across presentations, documents, reports, and web pages.
actual_capabilities: Shows an included PDF preview of all ten preset themes.
Provides named palettes with hex colors and paired header and body fonts.
Applies a selected theme consistently across an existing slide deck or artifact.
Checks contrast and readability while preserving each theme's visual identity.
Creates custom themes from user descriptions and presents them for review before application.
limitations: Requires a source artifact before it can apply styling.
Does not modify the included theme showcase PDF.
Uses specified fonts but does not install them or confirm their availability.
Custom theme quality depends on the detail of the user's visual requirements.

use_cases.title: Standardize investor presentations
use_cases.description: Apply one coherent palette and font system across a startup pitch deck.

use_cases.title: Create a new visual direction
use_cases.description: Generate a custom theme from brand goals, audience needs, and preferred visual tone.

use_cases.title: Improve recurring reports
use_cases.description: Use a readable preset theme across regular reports while preserving content and structure.

prompt_templates.title: Preview available themes
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the theme showcase and summarize the ten available themes. Ask me which theme I prefer before changing my artifact.
prompt_templates.scenario: Explore preset themes before making a selection.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a selected theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply Modern Minimalist to my presentation. Preserve all content, use the specified palette and fonts consistently, and check contrast on every slide.
prompt_templates.scenario: Style an existing artifact with a known preset.

prompt_templates.title: Compare themes for an audience
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Ocean Depths, Arctic Frost, and Modern Minimalist for an investor deck. Recommend one based on readability, audience, and data visualization needs.

prompt_templates.title: Design a custom accessible theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a pediatric health report. Use calm, accessible colors and readable fonts. Show it for approval before applying it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a tailored theme with accessibility constraints.

output_examples.input: Apply Ocean Depths to a financial consulting deck.
output: Selected Ocean Depths for its calm, professional maritime identity.
Applied deep navy, teal, seafoam, and cream across backgrounds, text, and accents.
Used DejaVu Sans Bold for headers and DejaVu Sans for body text.
Checked contrast and visual consistency across the deck.

output_examples.input: Create a theme for a pediatric health report using calm colors.
output: Created Gentle Harbor, a calm theme with soft blue, mint, warm white, and dark teal.
Paired a clear sans-serif header with a readable sans-serif body font.
Presented the theme for review before applying it to the report.

best_practices: Review the showcase before selecting a preset theme.
Confirm the chosen theme before changing the artifact.
Check font availability, contrast, and readability in the final output.
anti_patterns: Do not modify the theme showcase PDF.
Do not mix unrelated preset palettes without a clear design reason.
Do not apply a custom theme before the user reviews and approves it.

faq.question: Which artifacts can this skill style?
faq.answer: It can style presentations, documents, reports, landing pages, and other artifacts that support colors and fonts.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill includes ten preset themes with distinct palettes, typography, and suggested contexts.

faq.question: Can it create a custom theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate a named theme from your description, present it for review, and apply it after approval.

faq.question: What does each theme define?
faq.answer: Each theme defines a color palette, header and body fonts, a visual identity, and suitable presentation contexts.

faq.question: Does the skill modify the showcase PDF?
faq.answer: No. The showcase is only displayed so you can review the preset themes.

faq.question: Can the skill recommend a theme?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the audience, subject, tone, and accessibility needs so it can compare suitable themes.
